_comment: Editorial content for TSMF. This symbol is a closed-end fund, not an operating company, so products is empty and the description is about the scheme. headOffice is the fund's registered office. No image is attached.
description: Tri-Star Mutual Fund Limited is a closed-end mutual fund whose certificates are listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. Its principal activity is investing in the equity market, and its stated mission is to provide superior results through investment in quality growth stocks, on their potential for capital appreciation as well as dividend. Tri-Star Investments Ltd acts as its investment adviser.
headOffice: A/33, Central Commercial Area, Block 7/8, Main Shahrah-e-Faisal, KCHSU, Karachi 75350, Pakistan
